7.2.1.7.2 Exception base class
As a complement to the error condition enumeration, an exception base class for this
error domain also needs to be defined. This exception base class is used for the
transformation of an
ara::core::ErrorCode
object into an exception.
Additional exception types can be defined by the software module, but all these then
derive from this base type.
